run_ml_train_co2r: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with leave-one-composition-out cross validation
run_ml_train_her: run ML model training on HER experimental data with leave-one-out cross validation
run_ml_train_with_matminer: run ML training with Matminer elemental features added to the feature set
run_ml_train_from_processed_df: run ML training using a preprocessed dataframe instead of raw experimental and computational CSVs
run_ml_train_filter_matched: run ML training filtered to only XRD matched samples with a specific energy aggregation method
